ns2:course.label: International Taxation
ns2:course.description: This course analyzes the tax treatment, issues, planning techniques and underlying government policies involved in doing business internationally. The course incorporates concepts learned in all of the tax courses as they relate to the impact on cross border transactions, including source of income, inbound and outbound transfers, foreign tax credits, foreign currency transactions, controlled foreign corporations, Subpart F income, foreign taxpayers with US activities, treaties, and transfer pricing.
